description: A hosted processor page: kind payment pays one invoice (create fresh each send); setup saves a payer's card we never see; test makes a real test-mode payment proving the webhook seam.

kind.description: payment: pay one invoice. setup: save a card for later charges. test: prove the processor can reach this firm's books.

invoice_id.description: kind payment, required there: the invoice this link pays. Must be issued, overdue or partly paid.

return_url.description: payment: where the payer lands after paying (defaults to the firm's portal). setup, required there: where the browser returns; session_id is appended so the landing route can store the saved ids.

contact_id.description: kind setup, required there: whose card this is. Rides the session metadata so the return route knows.

email.description: kind setup: prefills the form and labels the processor customer.

provider.description: payment and test: only if the firm has several processors and this should not use their default.

secret_name.description: kind test, stripe and square: the name the test-mode key or sandbox token was stored under. PayPal reads paypal_client_id and paypal_secret.

amount.description: kind test: test amount, defaults per processor — no real money moves.
